description.en: Session toolbox framework for DeepSeek Harness with a host-side tool registry and client drawer shell, bundling hot-reloadable tools for Jira, Git history, workspace files, session trace, HTTP debugging, ports, calculator, usage, prompt, context, AI assistant, search, lineage and themes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话工具箱框架：Host 工具注册表 + Client 抽屉/面板壳，内置 Jira、Git 历史、工作区文件、会话轨迹、HTTP 调试、端口、计算、用量、提示词、上下文、AI 助手、搜索、血缘与主题等可热重载工具。
